DL-031_definition_match_difficulty_infla.severity: MEDIUM — pedagogical: items testing Bloom's Remember/Understand labeled Moderate (3) instead of Easy (1)
DL-031_definition_match_difficulty_infla.rationale: Of 1,228 Moderate items, ~500 (40%) are estimated to be definition-match pattern (DL-031). With 82% pool certification rate, ~410 Certified items carry inflation. Stem-keyword-to-CorrectChoice lexical overlap exceeds 50%, meaning answering requires reading comprehension only.
DL-031_definition_match_difficulty_infla.cognitive_mismatch: Current distribution: Remember=72 (2.8%), Understand=1276 (50.2%), Apply=1182 (46.5%). CAQS §6.2 target: Remember=5%, Understand=15%, Apply=40%. The 50.2% Understand rate is 3.3x over target, suggesting systematic over-labeling of memory-recall items.

EV3_missing_standard_citations.severity: MEDIUM — educational quality: ExplanationCorrect field lacks reference to governing accounting standard (ASC, COSO, IAS, IMA) on non-Remember/Understand items
EV3_missing_standard_citations.rationale: Per CAQS §4.1, every correct-answer explanation must name the governing principle. Of 2,221 Certified items, ~140 (6.3%) estimated to have weak/missing standard citations. Items at Remember/Understand level exempted.
EV3_missing_standard_citations.note: Requires full-pool EV3 scan for precise count; estimate based on Pack E Section C pattern (30% EV3 weakness in sampled sections).

DL-016_MODERATE_choice_metadata_mismatch.severity: LOW — metadata-only: ChoiceA–D ≠ Choices.A–D but EW text is topically correct for the learner-facing choices
DL-016_MODERATE_choice_metadata_mismatch.note: On items where DL-016 is MODERATE (metadata shift only, learner-facing content correct), this is a Gate 1 WARN, not HARD_FAIL. Items would be READY with warnings, not MINOR_FIX. Count overlaps with DL-008 items.
